program.intent: Position the open right hand above and beside the upright can for a side grasp, then refine alignment from the wrist view.

program.expected_change: The right hand rotates with fingers forward and palm left, bringing the can into a useful wrist-camera view without contacting it.

condition_order: predetermined, balanced; blocks run condition-major, operations inner

starts.adaptation: nominal start (reference prefix from the reset scene)
starts.note: grasp / transport fresh starts: can displaced 8 mm on its support at reset, then the reference prefix (transport: a physical grasp, never teleported); door: the nominal arrangement with the door 0.03-0.09 rad less open

score: J = S + 0.25 clip(P, -1, 1) - D - V; grasp: S = can >= 8 cm above its start AND within 0.12 m of the right fingertips at every step of a 15-step (0.5 s) hold; transport: S = env can_on_plate (xy < 0.09 m, |dz| < 0.02 m) after a 10-step settle; door: S = env closed criterion (>= upper - 0.2 range) after a 10-step settle; P: grasp sustained lift / 0.08, transport 1 - d_end / d_start, door angle progress / required; D: grasp can fell off its support or flung > 25 cm, transport can fell below the saucer by > 10 cm, door placed can knocked off the saucer; V: no existing constraint signal in this environment (always 0)

search.arms: A original, B fixed q0, C CEM-style update after attempt 5
search.bounded_sampling: per-dimension inverse-CDF truncated Gaussian, common uniforms per (operation, condition)

feedback: state-based evaluator (richer than the original visual / sparse success); never given mass, friction, future outcomes or optimal parameters
